module_outcomes: Apply logic and proof techniques to a wide variety of fields, including everyday applications.
Use deductive reasoning to solve problems.
Demonstrate familiarity of basic concepts in elementary number theory which include among others: properties of numbers, permutations and combinations, and arithmetic modulo .
Demonstrate familiarity with the terminology of recursion and graph
Solve simple problems using standard methods of recursion and graph
module_purpose: The overall goal of discrete mathematics is to study mathematical objects that are discrete rather than continuous. We will discuss a number of selected topics, mostly from the areas of mathematical logic, elementary number theory, graph theory, recursion and algorithms.
